_comment: Verification harness for PR #6162. Consumed by scripts/re-verify.sh. Production code is untouched on this branch; harnessPaths graft onto whatever the fixed code is. Polarity: 'contract' tests should PASS once fixed; 'canary' tests would FLIP to red and need inverting (there are none here — every claim is encoded as a contract test).

unit.note: -gcflags='all=-N -l' is required: the harness patches NewCacheFileUtil with gomonkey, which needs inlining disabled. Matches the repo's own LOCAL_FLAGS in the Makefile.

match: must not issue a cache-state RPC while permitSync() is closed
findings.claim: Restoring the Dataset phase must not issue a cache-state pod-exec RPC while the permitSync() rate limiter is closed.

match: must issue at most one cache-state RPC per limiter window
findings.claim: Across a not-ready -> ready flap inside one 5s limiter window, at most one cache-state RPC should be issued.

match: must restore the phase to Bound even while permitSync() is closed
findings.claim: Recovery must not depend on the limiter being open, otherwise recovery is merely delayed. GREEN on PR head; guards against a regressive fix for F1-a that simply gates the restore behind permitSync.

match: must restore the DatasetReady condition to True
findings.claim: The DatasetReady condition must be restored to True alongside the phase, not left False. GREEN on PR head; the PR's own test asserts only the phase.

liveNote: L3 needs a real cluster and is NOT run by re-verify.sh. Order: scripts/live/live-setup.sh (scales fluid-system/cacheruntime-controller to 0, after a pre-flight check that refuses if any CacheRuntime/Dataset not owned by this harness exists) -> scripts/live/live-flap.sh <manager-binary> <label> [flaps] [dwell] for each of the PR-built and master-built managers -> scripts/live/live-teardown.sh (restores the recorded replica count). live-scenario.sh is the simpler single-outage variant. Counter = the manager's own V(1) 'Exec command start' line (fileutils.go:55); do NOT try to count via shell redirection inside reportSummary, because pkg/utils/cmdguard rejects & ; $ ' ` ( ) || >> (exec_pipes.go:57). Key signals: exec_attempts vs limiter_windows_elapsed, restore_branch_hits, and phase-after per flap.

liveResults.conclusion: The PR fixes a real bug end-to-end (master is stuck Failed 5/5, PR recovers to Bound 5/5). F1's amplification did NOT reproduce live: +1 exec attempt total, against a ~10-window throttled ceiling, because a real not-ready->ready cycle (~10s, bounded by readiness-probe cadence) is longer than the 5s defaultSyncRetryDuration. F1 severity: minor. Recommended verdict: COMMENT, not REQUEST_CHANGES.

layersSkipped.integration: Deliberately skipped. An envtest layer would add only the real informer-cache lag, and L3 measures that directly by counting how many times the manager logs the restore branch for one outage. Building it would have meant puppeteering AdvancedStatefulSet status in a controller-less API server — a flaky duplicate of evidence L1 already provides deterministically.
